map.机油在使用中会氧化、吸湿并消耗添加剂，这些变化与时间相关而非仅与里程相关。长期短: In service oil oxidizes, absorbs moisture and burns off its additives, changes driven by time rather than mileage. Long spells of short slow running also let blow-by bring water and fuel dilution into the sump, forming emulsion, so counting months matters just as much.
